product_results.description: Step into a revolutionary auditory universe with the boAt Airdopes Plus 224, a cutting-edge pair of true wireless earbuds designed to bring multi-dimensional depth to your everyday routine. Powerful Spatial Audio, a spherical sound-mapping technology that envelops your head in a 360-degree sonic field to transform everyday video clips into theater-caliber blockbusters, revolutionizes your listening experience. This is powered by a large battery architecture that provides up to 60 hours of playback, easily fueling a full week of commuting and virtual meetings without wall chargers. The powerful 13mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound take complete control as soon as your playlist begins, producing deep, vibrating bass responses layered beneath incredibly clear, crisp vocals. The enhanced calling with 4 Mics and AI-ENx™ Technology uses artificial intelligence to isolate your voice while muffling surrounding wind and traffic noise on busy streets. Seamless Multipoint Connectivity lets you couple with two media sources simultaneously, switching fluidly between phone calls and laptop movie feeds. Thanks to integrated Google Fast Pair, creating an instantaneous, one-tap connection pop-up across compatible Android hardware takes less than a second. Using the incredibly responsive Ultra-Low Latency BEAST™ Mode (55ms) for mobile gaming guarantees that important audio cues are perfectly synchronized with your screen graphics. With complete boAt Hearables App Support, you can personalize your listening experience through the boAt app with access to EQ customization, Spatial Audio controls, along with Case Battery Information and other smart features. Backed by the drop-free wireless range of Advanced Bluetooth v6.0, the Airdopes Plus 224 is topped off with Instant Voice Assistant Access for hands-free control, making it the definitive wireless boost your lifestyle requires.

about_item: Powerful Spatial Audio: Revolutionize your daily media consumption with an advanced three-dimensional audio processor that accurately projects sound waves in a full sphere around you. This rich spatial processing injects incredible depth and multi-directional layers into ordinary mobile tracks, immediately upgrading casual video streams or casual gaming sessions into an expansive, theater-caliber environment.

Up to 60 Hours of Playtime: Banish low-battery panic from your hectic schedule with a staggering 60 hours of aggregate backup. Conquer back-to-back virtual conference calls, handle intense daily workout routines, and power through your favorite media binge-lists for days on end without looking for a charging brick. It provides continuous acoustic energy with zero unwanted power interruptions.

Enhanced Calling with 4 Mics and AI-ENx Technology: Dominate conversations even from the middle of loud, windy streets or bustling transit stations. An intelligent array of four microphones leverages sophisticated artificial intelligence to cleanly isolate your vocal frequencies while heavily suppressing background traffic roar and wind whistle. It guarantees you sound clear and professional on every call.

13mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound: IDive into a dense, beautifully textured audio landscape driven by massive 13mm precision-tuned dynamic drivers. Engineered specifically to voice our iconic boAt Signature Sound, these drivers deliver massive, low-frequency bass notes balanced under crisp, glistening vocals, giving you the perfect sonic adrenaline rush to smash through your personal fitness goals.

Seamless Multipoint Connectivity: Optimize your modern multi-device productivity by linking your true wireless buds to two separate Bluetooth sources simultaneously. This smart pairing engine lets you focus on an audio presentation on your office computer and fluidly routes audio the moment an urgent phone call hits your mobile screen, removing the frustration of manual connection toggling.

Google Fast Pair: Enjoy next-level Android ecosystem integration with rapid-discovery pairing mechanics. The absolute instant you flip open the charging case near your compatible Android smartphone or tablet, an intuitive connection prompt appears on your display for an effortless, single-tap setup that syncs across your entire Google account.

Ultra-Low Latency BEAST Mode (55ms): Eradicate disruptive lip-sync lag and plunge into high-stakes mobile matchmaking by firing up our dedicated ultra-responsive mode. Dropping latency down to a near-instantaneous 55ms, it perfectly locks critical tactical sound effects like approaching footsteps or gunshots to the graphics on your screen, so your reflexes always stay a step ahead.

Advanced Bluetooth v6.0:Experience uncompromised wireless range and superior power management powered by the next-generation Bluetooth v6.0 wireless standard. This premium architecture protects your stream against the audio stuttering and frequent disconnections common in signal-heavy public transit zones or busy offices, locking in a rock-solid link the second you step out.

boAt Hearables App Support: Maximize your hardware's full potential by pairing it with our sleek companion application. This multi-functional digital hub allows you to view granular, real-time power levels for the charging case and individual buds, run smart hardware health checks, and quickly install over-the-air firmware upgrades.

Instant Voice Assistant Access: Manage your incoming messages, calendar events, and digital environment completely hands-free. A swift, simple touch on the earbud casing instantly activates Siri or Google Assistant, enabling you to command navigation routing, draft quick replies, or change playlists while your smartphone stays safely packed away in your pocket.

summary.text: Customers find these earbuds to be of good quality with awesome sound quality. The battery life receives mixed feedback - while some praise the long backup, others report it discharging within 10 minutes. Moreover, connectivity, call quality, fit, and comfort receive mixed reviews, with some finding them easy to pair and crystal clear for calls, while others experience frequent disconnections and poor performance in open spaces. Additionally, reliability is a concern as some report one earbud stopping working properly.
